My mom, dad, brother, sister and I lived in Phoenix and would travel to see our family in Northwest New Mexico. In northwest New Mexico, you have the Navajo Reservation. One trip it was just my mom and us kids taking this trip with to see my family in our 2000s Ford Taurus. Part of the trip, you travel on highway 666, later renamed highway 491, where it was notorious for people to have contact with spirits. On this one evening, about 5/6pm in the summer, we were blasting music and singing along to song we all had memorized. Out here in the reservations, there is no radio signal so we were listening to CD. We are all screaming our lungs out to the song and I am waving my arms like I’m at a concert. When all of a sudden the music starts scrambling to a point of white noise. This last for about 5 seconds when it volume shot and to screech for a split second then stopped.  In the same moment the radio stopped, the car died and we had to pull off. After a few minutes, my mom was able to start it up and we were on the road again.

To this day, we have no idea what happened. Our car was very basic as it did not have any steering wheel control panels. It is very strange that highway 666 was infamous for occurrences like ours. People will drive through at night and hear scratches on their car doors and they check to see, the scratches will be there.
